bari shaan hai uss zaat ki jiss kay haath mein sari badshahi hai , aur woh her cheez per poori tarah qadir hai .
jiss ney moat aur zindagi iss liye peda ki takay woh tumhen aazamaye kay tum mein say kon amal mein ziyada behtar hai , aur wohi hai jo mukammal iqtidar ka malik , boht bakhshney wala hai ,
jiss ney saat aasman oopper tulay peda kiye . tum khudaye rehman ki takhleeq mein koi farq nahi pao gay .   abb phir say nazar dorra ker dekho kiya tumhen koi rakhna nazar aata hai-?
phir baar baar nazar dorrao , nateeja yehi hoga kay nazar thak haar ker tumharay paas na-murad loat aaye gi .

aur hum ney qareeb walay aasman ko roshan chiraghon say saja rakha hai , aur unn ko shetanon per pathar barsaney ka zariya bhi banaya hai ,   aur unn kay liye dehakti aag ka azab tayyar ker rakha hai .
aur jinn logon  ney apney perwerdigar say kufr ka moamla kiya hai , unn kay liye jahannum ka azab hai , aur woh boht bura thikana hai .
jab woh uss mein daalay jayen gay to uss kay daharney ki aawaz sunen gay , aur woh josh maarti hogi ,

aisa lagay ga jaisay woh ghussay say phatt parray gi . jab bhi uss mein ( kafiron ka ) koi giroh phenka jaye ga to uss kay mohafiz unn say poochen gay kay kiya tumharay paas koi khabrdar kernay wala nahi aaya tha-?

woh kahen gay kay haan beyshak humaray paas khabrdar kernay wala aaya tha , magar hum ney ( ussay ) jhutla diya , aur kaha kay :  Allah ney kuch nazil nahi kiya , tumhari haqeeqat iss kay siwa kuch nahi kay tum bari bhari gumrahi mein parray huye ho .
aur woh kahen gay kay :  agar hum sunn liya kertay aur samajh say kaam liya kertay to ( aaj ) dozakh walon mein shamil naa hotay .
iss tarah woh apney gunah ka khud aetraaf kerlen gay . gharz phitkaar hai dozakh walon per !
. ( iss kay bar-khilaf ) jo log ban dekhay apney perwerdigar say dartay hain , unn kay liye beyshak maghfirat aur bara ajar hai .
aur tum apni baat chupa ker kero , ya zor say kero , ( sabb uss kay ilm mein hai , kiyonkay ) woh dilon tak ki baaton ka poora ilm rakhney wala hai .
bhala jiss ney peda kiya wohi naa janey ? jabkay woh boht bareek-been , mukammal toor per ba-khabar hai !
wohi hai jiss ney tumharay liye zameen ko raam kerdiya hai , lehaza tum uss kay moondhon per chalo phiro , aur uss ka rizq khao , aur ussi kay paas dobara zinda ho ker jana hai .
kiya tum aasman walay ki iss baat say bey khof ho bethay ho kay woh tumhen zameen mein dhansa dey , to woh aik dum thar-tharaney lagay-?
ya kiya tum aasman walay ki iss baat say bey khof ho bethay ho kay woh tum per pathraon ki barish barsadey phir tumhen pata chalay ga kay mera darana kaisa tha-?
aur inn say pehlay jo log thay , unhon ney bhi ( payghumberon ko ) jhutlaya tha . phir ( dekh lo kay ) mera azab kaisa tha-?

aur kiya unhon ney parindon ko apney oopper nazar utha ker nahi dekha kay woh peron ko phelaye huye hotay hain , aur samett bhi letay hain . unn ko khudaye rehman kay siwa koi thamay huye nahi hai . yaqeenan woh her cheez ki khoob dekh bhaal kernay wala hai .
bhala khudaye rehman kay siwa woh kon hai jo tumhara lashkar ban ker tumhari madad keray-? kafir log to niray dhokay mein parray huye hain .
agar woh apna rizq band kerday to bhala woh kon hai jo tumhen rizq ata ker-sakay-? iss kay bawajood woh sarkashi aur beyzari per jamay huye hain .
bhala jo shaks apney mun kay ball ondha chal raha ho , woh manzil tak ziyada phonchney wala hoga ya woh jo aik seedhay raastay per seedha seedha chal raha ho-?
keh do kay :  wohi hai jiss ney tumhen peda kiya hai , aur tumharay liye kaan aur aankhen aur dil banaye . ( magar ) tum log shukar thora hi kertay ho .
keh do kay :  wohi hai jiss ney tumhen zameen mein phelaya , aur ussi kay paas tumhen ikattha ker kay ley jaya jaye ga .
aur yeh log kehtay hain kay : agar tum sachay ho to batao kay yeh wada kab poora hoga-?
keh do kay :  iss ka ilm to sirf Allah kay paas hai , aur mein to bus saaf saaf tareeqay per khabrdar kernay wala hun .
phir jab woh iss ( qayamat kay azab ) ko paas aata dekh len gay to kafiron kay chehray bigar jayen gay , aur kaha jaye ga kay :  yeh hai woh cheez jo tum maanga kertay thay .

. ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) kaho kay :  zara yeh batlao kay chahye Allah mujhay aur meray sathiyon ko halak kerday ya hum per reham farma dey , ( dono soorton mein ) kafiron ko dardnak azab say kon bachaye ga-?
keh do kay :  woh rehman hai , hum uss per emaan laye hain , aur ussi per hum ney bharosa kiya hai . chunacheh unqareeb tumhen pata chal jaye ga kay kon hai jo khuli gumrahi mein mubtala hai .
keh do kay :  zara yeh batlao kay agar kissi subha tumhara paani neechay ko utar ker ghaeeb hojaye to kon hai jo tumhen chashmay say ubalta huwa paani laaker deydey-?
